notes: Spark-X2.6-1.7B_int8.litertlm of litert-community/Spark-X2.6-1.7B: the INT8 file of the 1.7B, the faster 1.7B file on the Mac GPU. XHToken/Spark-X2.6-1.7B (Apache-2.0) converted to LiteRT-LM; the bundle carries templates/spark26_think.jinja (the vendor template's plain-chat part, thinking on by default, reasoning_effort high or low through extra_context), a `thought` channel and the repo's tokenizer.json byte for byte. Published 2026-10-31 (Hub main 587d8d94 at the read). Measured 2026-11-01 in the run r6.
quantization: dynamic INT8 (per-channel INT8 weights on every linear and the embedding, FP32 activations declared): litert-torch 0.9.3 export (dynamic_wi8_afp32), GPU graph rewrite (odml.cache_update / odml.runtime_bmm, weights byte-equal), prefer_activation_type fp32, 11 prefill signatures, KV cache 4,096
